title: Chat
description: Chat - encrypted messaging, live map and beacons over Reticulum, Bluetooth mesh and NOSTR relays (legacy APRS-IS optional).
summary: A messaging station with Reticulum as the primary transport: encrypted 1:1 and group messages ride the RNS network (with NOSTR-relay store-and-forward backup) and short-range Bluetooth broadcast, no licence needed. A messenger panel shows text messages addressed to you, a live map pinpoints stations and messages, and a beacon composer crafts position / status / emergency / timed beacons. Legacy APRS-IS access is opt-in only and requires a government-issued amateur-radio callsign with its verified passcode.
